title: Oral fluoride supplementation for children 6 months to younger than 5 years with fluoride-deficient water supply

source.quote: The USPSTF recommends that primary care clinicians prescribe oral fluoride supplementation starting at age 6 months for children whose water supply is deficient in fluoride.

action: Prescribe oral fluoride supplementation starting at age 6 months for children younger than 5 years whose water supply is deficient in fluoride

derived.min: Ages must be whole years; 6 months cannot be expressed. A child aged 1+ at Dec 31 has been at least 6 months old for at least half the year. This excludes some eligible infants aged 6-11 months rather than including ineligible infants under 6 months

derived.max: 'younger than 5 years' in whole years means age 4 or below

uncomputable.needs: whether the child's water supply is deficient in fluoride

all.quote: whose water supply is deficient in fluoride

uncomputable.needs: prescription of oral fluoride supplementation; the criterion grammar has no medication or prescription type
